It looks like something may have changed in `transformers` v5. When I try to run `convert_hf_to_gguf.py` it's erroring out with this as a missing key. It looks like that is no longer a standard key in the config object: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/main/src/transformers/models/modernbert/configuration_modernbert.py#L38

It looks like we now have several different ways to indicate the layer type for different hybrid patterns. This `DENSE_EVERY_N_LAYERS` implies a strictly periodic pattern. The above `SLIDING_WINDOW_PATTERN` appears to be for interleaved sliding window hybrid architectures, but strangely I don't see the corresponding key anywhere on the `c++` side ([here](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/src/llama-arch.cpp#L206)). We also use the fact that `head_count_kv` can be either a scalar or a list of scalars to differentiate recurrent vs attention layers for `GraniteHybrid` ([here](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/convert_hf_to_gguf.py#L8509)).

Since this is already fairly confusing and potentially redundent, I don't think we need to hold up this PR, but I'm curious if others can think of a clean way to accomplish the goal of layer type designation without a net-new `hparam`.
What's the reason for using `no_cache` here? Is this standard for all embedding models?
It looks like this is what `bert.cpp` uses, so probably standard. This also makes sense for embeddings since the assumption would be that each snippet to be embedded is unique.

I think `sliding_window_pattern` and `dense_every_n_layers` are basically the same thing, but is indeed missing support (probably forgotten at some stage), all models seem to just hardcode the `hparams.set_swa_pattern`.

I wonder if we can just reuse the `sliding_window_pattern` key instead and differentiate between loading a single integer and an array of bools instead of introducing a new key?

Alright, I think what we can do is make an overload of `llama_model_loader::get_key_or_arr` that has `uin32_t` as `result` (and no `n`) which simply fails if the metadata is an array.

That way we can `ml.get_key_or_arr` the `sliding_window_pattern` into an `uint32_t` (that has the previously hardcoded value as default) we feed to `hparams.set_swa_pattern`.
